info.title: BBC Sport - Rugby Universal API
info.description: Read BBC Sport rugby headlines and article links

get.description: Retrieves Bath rugby headlines from BBC Sport - Rugby.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

description.description: RSS item description, returned as an XML CDATA object.

guid.description: RSS GUID for the headline item.

link.description: Canonical BBC URL for the headline item.

pubDate.description: RFC 822 publication timestamp for the headline item.

title.description: RSS item title, returned as an XML CDATA object.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
